_about: Format of scripts/watchlist.json. Do not edit the real watchlist by hand; use scripts/watchlist.py add/list/due/mark. This example file only documents the entry shape.

_fields.deadline: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime; exactly as published, never guessed
_fields.fcfs: true for first-come-first-served / short windows needing early warning
_fields.project: project name as it appears in the source
_fields.source: REQUIRED: where the deadline was seen (URL, radar reference, or owner message + date)
_fields.wallet: burner = Hermes can execute (testnet/burner rules); owner = needs the owner (main wallet, mainnet, his signature/accounts)
_fields.what: what the deadline is: claim window, TGE, unlock, snapshot, registration close
_fields.where: claim page URL or the place the claim happens

entries.what: FCFS faucet-token claim round closes (first 1,000 wallets)
